title: Gentle Mobile — T2 artboards
brief: Native mobile client (Android first) that attaches over SSH/Tailscale to Gentle Shell agents inside Herdr TUI (lane A) or to a direct gentle-shell RPC session (lane B-i). Dark-only, tokens captured from Gentleman-Cute (default), Gentleman-Sexy and Gentle in design/system.md; chrome tokens follow the App palette extension there (bg/surface/surfaceRaised/borderSubtle/selection per theme, --terminal only on terminal surfaces). S6: no gesture-only action, 44 pt targets; S8: audio is dictation-to-text; S9: theme swap changes tokens only, never layout.

artboards.title: Pair — QR + short code + host command
artboards.tradeoff: QR and typed code are equal paths (scannable and rejected states shown side by side); the host-side helper prints both, so a broken camera never blocks pairing. Chrome: one surface — QR sits on it, short code and host command are hairline-separated blocks; instructions stated once in the subtitle; rejection is a left-rule notice, not a filled banner.

artboards.title: Nodes — hosts as hairline rows, state as a word
artboards.tradeoff: State is a plain word in secondary text (connected/reachable/unreachable), not a bordered chip — the list is already grouped, so a chip would repeat it; unreachable stays legible in the error colour without painting the row. Add-host is the single accent action (QR pairing kept as a quiet ghost button); search stays quiet.

artboards.title: Inbox — needs you → done → working → idle
artboards.tradeoff: Fixed sort order matches the spec; the connection-interrupted banner carries an explicit “Retry now” button rather than relying on pull-to-refresh.

artboards.title: Session — terminal surface, one-thumb controls, composer, extra keys
artboards.tradeoff: Pane switching and tab selection live in bottom strips (one-thumb zone) as buttons; Ctrl (sticky, shown pressed for Ctrl+A herdr compose) sits in the extra-keys row.

artboards.title: Compose — text, two image uploads, dictation, failure state
artboards.tradeoff: Two upload states shown side by side (64 % in-flight, 38 % failed with Retry); dictation is a quiet listening line with the partial transcript — no voice-clip UI (S8). Composer is a single 44 px pill: camera · textarea (44–96 px, no inner border) · paperclip · accent circle that is the microphone when empty and send when there is text.

artboards.title: Theme picker — Gentleman-Cute (default), Gentleman-Sexy, Gentle
artboards.tradeoff: Each card pairs a live mini terminal with a mini app-chrome in the same theme, proving chrome and terminal swap together while the card layout stays identical (S9).

artboards.title: Settings — security, lane toggle, theme, about, revoke
artboards.tradeoff: Host-key pinning renders as a locked-on switch (mandatory per P4) with a one-line plain explanation — 'Refuses a host whose SSH key changed.' — instead of a paragraph; lane segmented control defaults to B-i (direct gentle-shell RPC) per decision L4 and is the screen's only accent. Chrome: one surface, hairline rows; error colour reserved for Revoke.
